strengths.item: The paper is broadly well organized, with a conventional flow from introduction and related work to method, experimental setup, results, conclusion, and appendices.
The overall ICLR formatting is clean: body text, sectioning, margins, equations, and most tables are readable and easy to inspect.
The experimental setup is comparatively clear, identifying the teacher models, proxy model, student models, training corpora, benchmarks, and main baselines.
Main result tables, especially Tables 2 and 3, are mostly legible and have informative captions.

weaknesses.item: The central Bayesian prior/posterior formulation is notation-heavy and under-explained; important details such as the support and parameterization of token-probability random variables, the likelihood induced by proxy samples, and sparse KL computation are not easy to reconstruct from the main text.

Several reproducibility-critical hyperparameters and implementation details, including alpha, beta, gamma, n-gram order, posterior sampling rounds, and top-token sparsification, are mainly clarified in the appendix rather than near the method definition.

Several figures are visually compressed. Figure 2 is dense with small labels and arrows, while Figure 3 and Figures 4–5 have small axes, legends, tick labels, and trend details that are hard to inspect at page scale.

Some result narratives are terse and require readers to infer explanations from later appendix discussion, especially for degradation under excessive posterior sampling and proxy distribution disagreement.

dimension_review.evidence_summary: The PDF inspection found that pages 1, 4, 5, 6, 7 tables, and 8 table are generally readable, with standard ICLR-style formatting and clear captions. Page 2 Figure 1 is understandable but has small labels in the rightmost panel. Page 3 Figure 2 is visually dense and difficult to read without zooming. Page 7 Figure 3 and page 8 Figures 4–5 are too small for comfortable inspection of axes, legends, and bar or curve details. Text inspection found that Sections 3–5 are logically organized, but the Bayesian prior/posterior notation and implementation details are not fully explained in the main method section, with important clarifications deferred to Appendix A and Appendix B.
dimension_review.rationale: The paper is readable and inspectable overall, and its organization is reasonable. However, the presentation has notable weaknesses in two important areas: the main mathematical exposition leaves central objects and implementation details ambiguous, and several key figures are too compressed to easily verify the visual evidence. These issues go beyond minor polish problems, so the presentation is fair rather than good.
